hero.bio: 10+ years building software — the last 8 focused on mobile-first products with React Native and the React/TypeScript ecosystem. I've led two greenfield React Native apps end-to-end, from architecture to App Store and Google Play release pipelines. Currently at UpHill, automating clinical care journeys.

about.p1: I'm a senior mobile and frontend developer — mobile first — with over 10 years of experience, the last 8 building mobile-first products with React Native and the React/TypeScript ecosystem.
about.p2: I've shipped two greenfield React Native apps end-to-end: Liber at UpHill and Collibra for Mobile — owning everything from architecture to App Store and Google Play release pipelines.
about.p3: Beyond mobile I've built for the web, desktop and browser extensions — React, Electron, native iOS in Swift 5 — and I run an AI-assisted workflow with coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. This site itself is built and maintained with Claude Code.

uphill: Liber - Rewrite in React Native of the multiplatform application for Android, iOS and iPadOS.
Lanyard - Development of an RPA that navigates and extracts data from a web app.
UpHill - Maintenance and development of the platform interface used by doctors and nurses to manage patient journeys.
collibra: Collibra for Mobile - Development of a new multiplatform application for Android, iOS and iPadOS.
Data Marketplace - Development of a new portal that ensures users can intuitively find, understand, and collaborate with trusted data.
Collibra for Desktop - Development of a new multiplatform application for MacOS, Windows, and Linux.
Collibra Chrome Extension - Development of a new extension to run on Chromium based browsers that integrates with the Collibra platform.
Collibra for iOS - Maintenance and development of existing Swift 5 application for iOS and iPadOS.
Collibra Extension for Tableau - Development of a web extension that allows the integration of metadata from the Collibra Platform directly into Tableau Dashboards.
celfocus: Development of mobile apps for Android OS.
Development of back-end applications using Java EE, deployed using Docker on AWS EC2.
Development of front-end apps using JSF, or React.
Development of Skills for the Amazon Alexa service.
experience.premiumMinds: Development of the invoice library Billy for applications providing them with ability to create, manage, and store billing artifacts such as invoices and credit notes. It also supports the export of the persisted data in PDF and SAF-T formats.
